verdict.rationale: ClickHouse is a column-oriented analytical DBMS. First-party docs claim millisecond queries at petabyte scale and describe incremental materialized views that move aggregation cost to insert time for faster SELECTs. Independent users corroborate this: real-time aggregation over hundreds of millions of rows inserted daily, queries a couple orders of magnitude faster than Postgres, and use as a single-server data source for BI and in-product analytics, all without a separate warehouse. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation or benchmarks on dashboard-latency aggregation performance, and resolution of community-reported JOIN limitations that can affect complex analytical queries.
